named_method: unified diffusion-based biomolecular complex structure prediction
definition: A single model that jointly encodes protein, nucleic-acid, and small-molecule inputs and iteratively denoises 3D coordinates or frames to produce a complex structure.
assumptions: modality-specific tokenization is needed for proteins, nucleic acids, and ligands
3D prediction should be SE(3)-aware/equivariant or explicitly geometry-preserving
diffusion operates over noisy structural states with iterative denoising steps
cross-modal interaction pathways are required rather than independent monomer prediction
non_negotiable_structural_steps: separate modality encoders or token embeddings
cross-modal fusion / attention or graph message passing
diffusion noise schedule and denoising network

workspace_implementation_status.reason_unmet: workspace contains one protein-ligand sample and related-work PDFs but no multimodal training corpus or deep learning runtime stack
